title: 第110章 贼喊捉贼亲自盖章第109章 案牍库打卡全城戒严
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
案牍库内，死寂无声。
窗外的冷雨被冰蓝色的灵气死死挡在门槛之外。水珠在半空中凝结成冰晶，砸在青砖上摔得粉碎。
苏寒双手捧着重达十斤的玄铁大印。
他佝偻着脊背，双腿在破旧的官服下不住地打着摆子。呼吸粗重，夹杂着残破风箱拉扯的嘶鸣。
每向前迈出一步，左腿都在灰尘密布的地面上拖出一条长长的痕迹。
苍穹榜第一，林彩衣。
她端站在书案对面。七彩霞衣一尘不染，眉心的朱砂透着高高在上的神性。冰蓝色的眸子，冷漠地注视着这具行将就木的底层皮囊。
两人之间的距离，不到三尺。
苏寒甚至能闻到她身上那股千年冰髓散发出的冷香。那股寒气针扎一般刺入他的毛孔，将他额头冒出的冷汗冻成了细密的白霜。
他低着头，视线落在书案正中央的羊皮通缉令上。
画像栩栩如生。
那个名叫“厉飞雨”的凶神，满脸横肉，左脸颊挂着一条丑陋的蜈蚣刀疤。眼神透着屠戮苍生的暴虐与疯狂。
那是苏寒亲手捏造出来的脸。
那是在黑风毒沼里，一剑斩下五颗天骄头颅的真正死神。
而此刻，这头死神正披着最窝囊、最卑微的八品文书皮套。站在一群发誓要将他千刀万剐的苦主面前。
苏寒腾出一只手。
干瘪、布满老茧的指尖，掀开桌面上那个盛满腥红朱砂的铜盒。
刺鼻的血腥味混合着陈年水银的气味，直冲鼻腔。
他双手握住玄铁大印的顶端。手腕因为用力过猛，青筋根根凸起，剧烈颤抖。
官印的底部，深深按入朱砂泥中。

殷红的粘稠印泥，挂满了代表着长河州府最高法理的篆体大字。
苏寒举起大印。
手臂在半空中晃了两下。悬停在通缉令的右下角。
“动作快点！没吃饭吗！”
林彩衣身后的一名神宗剑客按住剑柄，满脸暴躁地怒喝。通缉令晚下发一刻，那个杀人魔头就多一分逃出州府的可能。
苏寒缩了缩脖子。
双手猛地向下发力。
“砰！”
沉闷的撞击声在案牍库内炸响。震得残破的檀木书案再次发出一声哀鸣。
玄铁大印重重地砸在羊皮卷上。
鲜红的朱砂印记，死死咬住了羊皮纸的纹理。将“长河州府玄衣卫镇抚司印”几个大字，清晰无比地烙印在画像的下方。
官方认证，法理成型。
从这一刻起，这道追杀“厉飞雨”的最高级别海捕文书，将通过玄衣卫的暗线，贴满大荒域的每一座城池、每一个村落。
贼喊捉贼。
亲手为自己的死刑执行书，盖下最具权威的公章。
苏寒双手握着官印边缘。一点点将其拔起。
大印离开羊皮纸的瞬间，拉出几丝粘稠的红色朱砂线。
他将玄铁大印小心翼翼地放在书案角落。
李主事站在一旁，长长地吐出一口浊气。后背的官服早已被冷汗浸透。
“林仙子。大印已盖。下官立刻派八百里加急，将拓本送往各处关卡！”李主事弯着腰，脸上堆满讨好的笑容。

林彩衣不置可否。转身准备离开这间充满霉味的破屋子。
那名神宗剑客冷哼一声，伸手去拿那卷盖好章的通缉令。
就在剑客的手指即将触碰到羊皮卷的千分之一秒内。
一只干枯、布满黑色泥垢的手掌，突兀地按在了通缉令的边缘。
挡住了剑客的动作。
content_en:
There was deathly silence in the archives.
The cold rain outside the window was blocked by the icy blue aura. The water droplets condensed into ice crystals in mid-air, hitting the green bricks and shattering into pieces.
Su Han held a large black iron seal weighing ten kilograms in both hands.
His back was hunched, and his legs were swinging under the worn official uniform. His breathing was heavy, mixed with the roar of a broken bellows.
With each step forward, his left leg dragged a long trace on the dusty ground.
Number one on the sky list, Lin Caiyi.
She stood opposite the desk. The colorful rosy clothes are spotless, and the cinnabar between the eyebrows reveals the aloof divinity. Ice blue eyes stared indifferently at the dying body.
The distance between the two is less than three feet.
Su Han could even smell the cold fragrance of the thousand-year-old ice marrow on her body. The cold air penetrated his pores like needles, freezing the cold sweat on his forehead into fine white frost.
He lowered his head and his eyes fell on the sheepskin wanted notice in the center of the desk.
The portrait is lifelike.
The fierce god named "Li Feiyu" has a face full of flesh and an ugly centipede scar hanging on his left cheek. His eyes revealed the cruelty and madness of killing the common people.
That was a face fabricated by Su Han himself.
That was the real God of Death who chopped off the heads of five geniuses with one sword in the Black Wind Poison Swamp.
At this moment, this god of death is wearing the most cowardly and humble eighth-grade clerical leather sheath. Standing in front of a group of torturers who vowed to cut him into pieces.
Su Han freed up a hand.
With dry, calloused fingertips, he opened the copper box filled with red cinnabar on the table.
The pungent smell of blood mixed with the smell of old mercury rushed straight into the nose.
He held the top of the Black Iron Seal with both hands. The veins in my wrists were bulging due to excessive exertion, and they were shaking violently.
The bottom of the official seal is deeply pressed into the cinnabar mud.
The thick red ink pad is covered with large seal characters representing the highest legal principles of Changhe Prefecture.
Su Han raised the big seal.
His arms swung twice in mid-air. Hover over the lower right corner of the wanted poster.
"Hurry up! Haven't you eaten yet?"
A Shenzong swordsman behind Lin Caiyi held down the hilt of his sword and shouted angrily. The moment the arrest warrant is issued late, the murderer has an extra chance of escaping from the state capital.
Su Han shrank his neck.
His hands were pushed downwards violently.
"Bang!"
A dull crashing sound exploded in the archives. The shattered sandalwood desk let out a wail again.
The black iron seal hit the parchment hard.
The bright red cinnabar mark clung to the texture of the parchment. The large characters "Changhe Prefecture Xuanyiwei Town Fusi Seal" were clearly imprinted on the bottom of the portrait.
Official certification, legal basis.
From this moment on, this highest-level sea arrest document to hunt down "Li Feiyu" will be posted all over every city and village in the wilderness through the hidden line of Xuanyi Guards.
The thief shouts to catch the thief.
He personally stamped his execution document with the most authoritative official seal.
Su Han held the edge of the official seal with both hands. Pull it up little by little.
The moment the large seal left the parchment, a few sticky red cinnabar threads were pulled out.
He carefully placed the black iron seal in the corner of the desk.
Manager Li stood aside and let out a long breath. The official uniform on the back was already soaked with cold sweat.
"Fairy Lin. The seal has been affixed. The official immediately sent eight hundred miles to rush to deliver the rubbings to various checkpoints!" Manager Li bent over, with a flattering smile on his face.
Lin Caiyi was noncommittal. Turn around and prepare to leave this musty shabby house.
The Shenzong swordsman snorted coldly and reached for the stamped wanted notice.
Just a thousandth of a second before the swordsman's finger was about to touch the parchment.
A dry palm covered with black dirt suddenly pressed against the edge of the wanted notice.
Blocking the swordsman's movement.
